links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of AI-generated spinal surgery patient education materials
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 FKGL 7.2 to 9.0, followed by ChatGPT-4o; ChatGPT-o3 had the lowest readability (FKGL > 10.4).
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1 produced the most readable responses, with Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (FKGL) scores ranging from 7.2 to 9.0, succeeded by ChatGPT-4o.

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks the readability and quality (using DISCERN and Flesch-Kincaid) of patient education materials generated by four LLMs for spinal surgeries, without evaluating a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
